text:
emma: quick sync - we keep seeing late token arrivals rewrite ownership and break downstream billing joins. thinking about a strict boundary between ingest
nd accounting so we don't have to replay everything
raj: same. ingest currently writes an enriched claim that finalizer mutates. finalizer replacing ownership is the issue
sophia: is finalizer doing replace-on-late or append-adjust?
emma: replace-if-newer. invoices assume append-only proofs; replacing invalidates already-issued charge batches
mike: two paths: (A) make ingest emit compensating adjustment events (append-only) so consumers can apply deltas, or (B) centralize resolution in a reconciler that emits canonical, immutable ownership events
raj: A keeps ingest simple but every consumer must handle adjustments. B centralizes logic but adds reconciliation latency
emma: hybrid idea: ingest writes ephemeral candidate_claim rows + emits a lightweight proto-event with a provenance pointer. reconciler seals once stable and writes canonical append-only ledger event. billing reads the ledger only
sophia: how do we define "stable"? watermark + change-window sounds fine. reuse existing watermark/service window
mike: also: include provenance_id and a snapshot pointer in the canonical event so audits can reconstruct history. example shape as string: 
```json
{"event_id":"sha256(pv||epoch)", "tenant":"acme", "ts":"2026-03-21T15:00:00Z", "ownership":[{"acct":"acct-1","tokens":123}], "provenance_id":"pv_abc123", "provenance_s3":"s3://redwood/pv_abc123.json"}
```
raj: reconciler must be idempotent and resumable. deterministic event_id for de-dupe.
emma: ops: reconciler needs strong observability (why sealed, policy used). SLA for Dedicated customers.
sophia: failure modes: reconcile lag => billing delay. fallback: ingest can emit a coarse-grained safe event when reconciler is behind threshold so billing keeps flowing
mike: infra-bot: reconcile job scheduled: reconcile-run-2026-03-21T15:00Z :white_check_mark:
emma: next steps: I'll prototype candidate table + simple reconciler in staging and open a short RFC with sequence diagrams, reconcile latency targets, expected storage/cost. anyone object?
sophia: no objections. please include masking rules for provenance snapshots (strip PII or encrypt)
raj: +1 on encryption + access controls for snapshots
mike: i'll draft fallback SLA/alerting notes
emma: thanks all, i'll post RFC link when ready. ping me to pair on checkpointing design if you want
